K_means: Number of labels used in head gradient training, not total labels available
development_usage: All fresh backbone heads and target-only MLP select checkpoint using the same fixed256 labelled development objects; no gradients on development
numeric_kNN_and_affine: Use K fitted labels; no additional labelled hyperparameter calibration. Development labels are available under the same task protocol but not needed by these fixed baselines.
interpretation: Learning curves compare representation sample efficiency at a fixed extra256-label development cost; never describe K as total target-supervision cost.
